What to look for: the two BufferStore calls. A correct compile emits the
values written to `m` after its declaration (1,2,3 and 4,5,6). This dxc
build instead emits the matrix's DECLARATION-time constants (42,43,44 and
45,46,47), silently discarding the two assignments to `m` that run before
the const-qualified struct init `const S a = {m};`.
